issues.body:

This adds separate JS wall instrumentation and a collapsible details panel while preserving the existing inference FPS, draw FPS, processingMs eligibility/labels and 250 ms publication cadence. Instrumentation only; no identity, mask, coordinate, Worker, frame-thinning, dictionary or TTS redesign.

**Author checkpoint, awaiting independent review assigned by the parent.** No independent PASS, merge, auto-merge or deployment is claimed.

[Full evidence](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/README.md) · [measurement contract](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/measurement-contract.md) · [requirement/test matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/requirement-test-matrix.md) · [commands/exits](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/final-commands.json) · [source/bundle binding](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/source-binding.json) · [overhead report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/04a3530c6ec9755bb7b89c3e31c1c3e15c9b1ea9/docs/verification/pr06/overhead-report.md).

Capture covers every bootstrap/arrival/execution attempt, including duplicates that never infer; comparison covers every samePixels call outside capture too. Queue records actual timer reservation wait. Job records lock occupancy including cancelled/stale owners. SDK, exclusive summed postprocess, input/result cleanup, inclusive engine, actual Canvas API work and first-draw latency have explicit separate boundaries/outcomes. Never sum their overlapping intervals. Capture duty is captureInput-only completed-interval duration / fixed 5000 ms, with its completion-window boundary effect disclosed; it is not CPU utilization or full observation cost.

First-draw identity binds generation + job + the **execution recapture** actually handed to SDK work. Latency starts at that immutable capture's JS start and ends after the first successful matching Canvas copy API return; queue commonly lies before this image. Live quality-counter video input is unbound/not applicable. Empty successful results can draw; overwritten/hidden/cancelled/failed/expired/capacity results get separate outcomes, never fabricated 0 ms latency. Physical raster/compositor/presentation and camera-to-display latency remain unknown.

Statistics use inclusive five-second windows, finite nonnegative durations including real 0 ms, even median and nearest-rank p95. Counts/mean/max/totals cover retained events (2048 per stage/outcome); in-window eviction explicitly marks partial coverage. Quantiles separately report latest-300 valid-sample coverage. Every store/map is bounded, pending result retention is 64/5 seconds, bad clocks and observer/statistics exceptions are isolated, generations invalidate old measurements, and no sorting occurs every RAF. Details toggles use native disclosure state and do not reinitialize camera/model/scheduler or change selection/speech.

Local final-source validation: locked install; typecheck; lint; **250 unit tests**, **121 focused cases**, production build, **19 real React/CSS browser cases**, **7 controls** (2 intact and 5 expected fault detections), normal-bundle test-double audit and diff checks pass. Exact unmodified baseline also passes 187 tests. Original PR01–05 assertions/fractional-edge controls remain. A final author self-check fixed a stopped fatal-fault snapshot retaining stale data and added its App regression; no reviewer finding is represented as independently closed.

**Overhead:** 288 measured alternating trials, 12 paired trials per resolution/path/model, warmup excluded, 640×480 / 1280×720 / 1920×1080, RGBA and VideoFrame, both model doubles. Actual work counts match (6912 processed/SDK/drawn jobs total); disabled instrumentation has zero extra metric clock/snapshot calls. Snapshot/quantile plus actual React/DOM preparation is included and separately reported; synthetic every-eight-source-frame publication weighting, brief concurrent focused-test noise, variance and all unfavorable deltas are disclosed. For example 1080p RGBA detector paired mean-delta median +3.0719 ms, paired p95 +19.2188 ms; negative/noisy deltas also remain. No arbitrary 1 ms budget or real-device guarantee. Initial lifetime-versus-window harness failure and earlier sweep remain preserved, not overwritten.

Cloud Node 24.19.0 / repository-pinned npm 11.9.0 / system Chromium 154.0.8037.57 locally. Initial default-cache npm install ENOENT was resolved using /tmp cache. The prior matched-browser download denial was respected without retry/bypass. Synthetic camera/SDK/timer driver and shared actual Canvas operations are distinguished from real physical camera/model/GPU/audio/mobile/background/public-deployment equality, which remain unverified. Prior T01 timing sensitivity is retained; local suites ran serially with no blanket retry, sleeps/timeouts increase or weakened assertion.

**Final-head hosted CI: completed/success.** [Run 40106484147 / job 120909128538](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40106484147/job/120909128538) passes locked install, typecheck, lint, **250 unit / 19 browser / 7 controls** and build. Artifact **12565255856** names the same head SHA; digest `sha256:d99e4b6809f7952d1087d35858526cba38baf70fff5e469ce1c7d39059344b01`. Public branch/FETCH_HEAD and immutable tree readback match the frozen HEAD/tree above; main remains at the base. Local working tree is clean. No older CI is substituted.

Changed product/test paths: PipelineMetrics/Probe service; scheduler and engine instrumentation; shared Canvas renderer extraction; PipelineDetails and VisionCanvas bridge; appended scheduler/Canvas tests, new statistics/engine timing tests and three browser cases. [Report](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/REPORT.md) · [Per-finding closure and conditions](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/findings.json) · [Requirement matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/requirement-test-matrix.md) · [Reproduction](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/REPRODUCE.md) · [Independent native app observations](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/logs/independent-app-observations.json) · [Adapter audit](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/observer-adaptations.md) · [CPU/resource observations](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/aecb10979c6e691b4347d7fa1fa07db6a7af7eb9/docs/verification/pr04-rereview2/logs/pixel-cost.json)

The missing/zero-capability paths now identify actual sampled RGBA bytes and dimensions and send the same private owned canvas to the SDK. Independent real App/Canvas/Engine tests in both rVFC and RAF infer unchanged content once, age measurements correctly, accept changed pixels and changed dimensions (even with the same byte sequence), handle inference/readback failures explicitly and retry without camera/model recreation. A fresh identical native presentation near input expiry does not renew content age. Full SDK-input pixels/dimensions are compared to an independent video reference; canvas source PTS is null.

**Nonblocking conditions:** this fallback intentionally coalesces identical-content frames, so its stalled state describes unchanged content rather than proof of missing camera frame arrivals. Full-image main-thread polling is O(width×height) and expensive: local synthetic equal-content polls averaged about **44 ms at 720p and 94 ms at 1080p**. These are observations, not universal bounds or model/GPU performance. Physical camera/model/GPU/audio, hardware background and cross-platform/deployment behavior remain unverified. Preserve these explicit limits; no new latency budget or Worker migration is imposed. Prior R01 future async lock-wakeup risk remains nonblocking.

Independently replayed PR #9 unit **11/11**, native matrix **6/6**, actual-app **3/3**, forced-delay **6/6**, original native first-frame one per path. New independent pixel boundaries **17/17**, direct-observer native app cases **4/4**, four resolution/resource structural checks pass.

A separately inspected logical positive-quality adapter gives **29/29 unchanged assertions** and is not used as absence-path proof. issues.body:
